commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Davros, Dalek Creator ({1}{U}{B}{R} 3/4 menace legendary artifact Alien Scientist, not a Dalek): at the beginning of our end step, if an opponent lost 3+ life this turn, create a 3/3 menace Dalek; then each opponent who lost 3+ faces a villainous choice (we draw, or they discard). The condition is checked on resolution, so Wound Reflection, Perforating Artist and Missy can be ordered first. The deck: (1) qualifies opponents on our turn — Boltwave, Maestros Charm, Loyal Subordinate, Court of Ambition, Torment of Hailfire, Ensnared by the Mara, menace Daleks; the candidate adds Bloodletter (doubling), Purphoros (2 per creature entry), Fiery Confluence, Tectonic Giant, Unlicensed Disintegration; (2) multiplies the trigger and the choice — Roaming Throne naming Alien/Scientist, Strionic Resonator, Scientist Supreme, Auton Soldier (non-legendary Davros), The Valeyard (each choice twice); (3) punishes discards — Waste Not, Geth's Grimoire, Tinybones, Entropic Battlecruiser, and now Tergrid for permanents; Sygg draws whenever an opponent lost 3+.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (registry ceiling 4, Optimized; Grok estimate 4). Game Changers: baseline 5 (Ancient Tomb, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Jeska's Will); candidate 6 (+Tergrid, God of Fright). Commander Spellbook: 0 included combos for baseline and candidate. Bloodletter + Wound Reflection is a finite doubling, not a loop. No infinite is claimed.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add serves Davros's own end-step Oracle (life loss on our turn, or punishing the discard/sacrifice choice). Generic staples (Rhystic Study, Vampiric Tutor, Sheoldred) and off-turn punishers (Painful Quandary, Torment of Scarabs) were rejected. Distinctness vs Deck #11 Cult of Skaro (PR #659): the Davros baseline already shares 53 nonbasic names with the #11 candidate and this candidate shares 52 (18 lands and 34 nonlands; Davros, Dalek Creator is himself one of #11's 99; The Cyber-Controller, shared in the baseline, is cut here; none of the six adds is in #11). Shared nonland core: Cult of Skaro, The Dalek Emperor, Dalek Drone, Dalek Squadron, Genesis of the Daleks, Doomsday Confluence, Exterminate!, Missy, Ashad, Cyberman Patrol, Auton Soldier, Roaming Throne, Strionic Resonator, Scientist Supreme, Padeem, Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Cyber Conversion, Delete, Their Name Is Death, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick, Mox Opal, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, three Talismans, Enthusiastic Mechanaut. The overlap is significant and disclosed. The commander-first difference: #11 multiplies Cult's attack trigger (extra combats, clones, haste); Davros wants every opponent to lose 3+ life on our turn and then faces them with a villainous choice. Davros-only core: Boltwave, Maestros Charm, Loyal Subordinate, Court of Ambition, Torment of Hailfire, Wound Reflection, Perforating Artist, Sygg, Tinybones, Geth's Grimoire, Waste Not, Entropic Battlecruiser, Sycorax Commander, The Valeyard, Ensnared by the Mara, This Is How It Ends, Tezzeret, Labyrinth Raptor, plus all six adds (none is in #11).

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (94 library rows: Island x2, Mountain x3, Swamp x3, the rest 1x).
Roles:
- 34 lands incl. Ancient Tomb, Urza's Saga, Plaza of Heroes, Training Center, Luxury Suite, Morphic Pool, Xander's Lounge, Otawara, Geier Reach Sanitarium, Urborg, City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Fiery Islet, Exotic Orchard, Command Tower, five fetches and six original/shock duals.
- Ramp: Sol Ring, Mox Opal, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, three Talismans; reducer Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
- Life-loss enablers: Boltwave, Maestros Charm, Loyal Subordinate, Court of Ambition, Torment of Hailfire, Wound Reflection, Perforating Artist, Ensnared by the Mara, Sycorax Commander, This Is How It Ends, Dauthi Voidwalker.
- Trigger/choice multipliers: Roaming Throne, Strionic Resonator, Scientist Supreme, Auton Soldier, The Valeyard, Ashad.
- Discard payoffs: Waste Not, Geth's Grimoire, Tinybones, Entropic Battlecruiser, Tezzeret; Sygg is a life-loss payoff (draw when an opponent lost 3+).
- Dalek/Cyberman army: Cult of Skaro, The Dalek Emperor, Dalek Drone, Dalek Squadron, Genesis of the Daleks, Doomsday Confluence, Cyberman Patrol, Cybermen Squadron, The Cyber-Controller (cut), Death in Heaven (cut), Missy, Labyrinth Raptor.
- Interaction: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Swan Song (cut), Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Snuff Out, Deadly Rollick, Feed the Swarm, Cyber Conversion, Delete, Exterminate!, Cyclonic Rift, Vandalblast (cut), Blasphemous Act (cut), Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death, Weeping Angel (cut).
- Card flow/tutors: Demonic Tutor, Jeska's Will.
- Protection: Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Padeem.
Overlaps: Blasphemous Act and Toxic Deluge both kill our own board, two pure-defence cards (Weeping Angel, Swan Song), a slow Saga (Death in Heaven) and an X-cost Cyberman lord with no life-loss text; significant overlap with Deck #11 (see commander_identity).
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline: 34 physical lands; heuristic land colour sources U19 B18 R18; average nonland MV 3.185; 24 instants/sorceries; 23 creatures; 24 artifacts; pips U23 B41 R19. Candidate: 34 lands, sources unchanged (no land swaps); average nonland MV 3.231; 23 instants/sorceries; 25 creatures; 22 artifacts in the 99 (23 with Davros); pips U19 B44 R23. Bloodletter's BBB and Fiery/Tectonic RR rely on 18 B / 18 R land sources plus Talismans, Signet, Fellwar and Urborg.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat (Swan Song cut). Removal: Unlicensed Disintegration (new), Snuff Out, Deadly Rollick, Feed the Swarm, Cyber Conversion, Delete, Exterminate!, This Is How It Ends, Cyclonic Rift, Fiery Confluence (artifacts), Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death. Protection: Greaves, Boots, Padeem. Weak points: empty-handed opponents can pick the impossible discard (701.55b); lifegain; artifact wipes; fewer counters after cutting Swan Song; Dauthi Voidwalker vs Tergrid anti-synergy.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: An approved Bracket 4 Davros list (2026-10-14) with strong one-card table enablers (Boltwave, Maestros Charm, Loyal Subordinate) and discard payoffs. M6 Pass C kept it (NEEDS TESTING, 0 measured playtests) and asked for measured tests of Unlicensed Disintegration, Ingenious Artillerist and Fiery Confluence. Remaining weaknesses: three self-damaging wipes, defensive cards with no life-loss text, a 7-mana Cyberman lord shared with Deck #11, and no amplifier for partial life loss.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Davros optimized 14/103 (absent from general/upgraded pages, so effectively OFF-RANKING for most lists); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {1}{B}{B}{B} 2/4 flying Vampire Demon: if an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Death in Heaven ({3}{B} Saga: chapters I-II mill two and exile a player's graveyard, chapter III returns the exiled creature cards face down as 2/2 Cyberman artifacts under our control), a slow value card that takes two turns to pay off.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Davros's whole condition is 'an opponent lost 3 or more life this turn' on our turn. Bloodletter halves that threshold: every 2 points becomes 4. Boltwave becomes 6 each, Fiery Confluence 12 each, Loyal Subordinate 6, Purphoros 4 per creature, Tectonic Giant 6, a single unblocked Dalek token 6. It also doubles Wound Reflection's end-step loss (ordered before Davros), Perforating Artist, Court of Ambition, Torment of Hailfire, and Entropic Battlecruiser, so opponents pay more for choosing life.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: BBB pips (B sources 18 + rocks); a 2/4 flyer that is the obvious lightning rod; legendary. Only on our turn. Its land back face means it is never dead.
material_candidates.reason: The single most commander-specific card found: it converts every partial life loss into a Davros qualification on our turn. Doubling is finite (no loop); Spellbook lists no included combo with the 100.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Davros general 1783/6007, upgraded 175/615, optimized 25/103; M6 Pass C hypothesis #1 (over Weeping Angel); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {1}{B}{R} instant: destroy target creature; if you control an artifact, it deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Weeping Angel ({1}{U}{B} flash artifact Angel; it stops being a creature when an opponent casts a creature spell). Pass C noted this costs a 3-mana flash body.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Hard instant removal that, cast on our turn with an artifact out (23 artifacts incl. Davros), qualifies its target's controller for Davros. The bounded Pass C test enumerates legal/illegal target x artifact x own/other turn x prior loss: it kills in all 8 legal-target cases and newly qualifies exactly 1 of 16 (legal, artifact, our turn, no prior loss) — one opponent, never all.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Fizzles entirely to hexproof/protection or sacrifice in response (608.2b: no damage either). Off our turn the 3 damage does not count for Davros's end step.
material_candidates.reason: Pass C's exact pairing. Weeping Angel is a defensive body with no life-loss text; Disintegration is removal that also feeds the commander.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Davros general 1091/6007, upgraded 182/615, optimized 39/103; live Scryfall batch (Game Changer)
material_candidates.role: {3}{B}{B} 4/5 menace legendary God (MDFC): whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent or discards a permanent card, you may put that card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. Back face Tergrid's Lantern: {T}: target player loses 3 unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses The Cyber-Controller ({X}{U}{U}{B}: each opponent mills X and we take the milled creatures as 2/2 Cybermen; other artifact creatures +1/+1), an army payoff shared with Deck #11.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Davros's villainous choice offers 'discard a card'; Court of Ambition, Torment of Hailfire, Perforating Artist, Sycorax Commander, the edicts in The Dalek Emperor, Doomsday Confluence and Labyrinth Raptor offer or force discard/sacrifice. Tergrid turns each permanent paid into our permanent, so the safe option becomes the expensive one and pushes opponents toward life loss, which is what Davros wants. Menace body like Davros.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Game Changer (Bracket 4 count 5 -> 6). Opponents pick which card to discard and can discard nonpermanents, or choose an impossible option when empty-handed (701.55b). Anti-synergy: Dauthi Voidwalker exiles those cards (disclosed).
material_candidates.reason: Converts the deck's punisher choices into card advantage; the Game Changer is disclosed and the deck is already Bracket 4.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from every Davros EDHREC page); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {3}{R} indestructible legendary enchantment creature God: whenever another creature you control enters, deal 2 damage to each opponent; {2}{R}: creatures get +1/+0.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Blasphemous Act (often 1-mana symmetric 13-damage wipe), which also kills Davros, our Daleks and Cybermen.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Every Dalek token (Davros, The Dalek Emperor, Genesis of the Daleks, Doomsday Confluence, Cult of Skaro), every myriad token (Dalek Squadron, Auton Soldier, Cybermen Squadron) and every creature spell deals 2 to each opponent. Two entries qualify the table; one entry with Bloodletter does. The bounded Pass C test shows it qualifies all opponents on a 2-token myriad batch where Ingenious Artillerist does not, and it survives destroy effects.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Not a creature below devotion 5, so no body early; exile/bounce still answer it. Losing the cheapest wipe leaves Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death (spares our artifact Daleks) and Cyclonic Rift.
material_candidates.reason: An indestructible table-wide life-loss engine keyed to the tokens Davros and the Dalek package already make; Blasphemous Act works against our own board.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from every Davros EDHREC page); M6 Pass C hypothesis (Fiery vs Boltwave/Maestros Charm); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {2}{R}{R} sorcery, choose three (repeats allowed): 1 damage to each creature; 2 damage to each opponent; destroy target artifact.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Vandalblast ({R} one artifact, or overload {4}{R} all opponents' artifacts), the deck's one-sided artifact sweep.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: 2-2-2 deals 6 to each opponent (12 with Bloodletter) and cannot be fizzled; 2-2-artifact keeps 4 each plus targeted artifact removal; up to three artifacts for 4 mana. The bounded test compares it with Boltwave (3 each, MV 1) and Maestros Charm (3 each, MV 3): all three qualify the table alone, Fiery is the one that also answers artifacts.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Sorcery. Pass C's failure case is real: if the chosen artifact target becomes illegal, the whole spell does not resolve and the damage is lost (608.2b), so choose 2-2-2 when an artifact may vanish. No overload-style one-sided sweep any more.
material_candidates.reason: Redundant enabler plus flexible artifact hate in one card; Vandalblast's overload is the honest loss.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Davros general 1093/6007, upgraded 100/615, optimized 21/103; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {2}{R}{R} 3/4: whenever it attacks or becomes the target of an opponent's spell, choose one: 3 damage to each opponent, or impulse-draw one of the top two.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Swan Song ({U} counter for enchantment/instant/sorcery; gives the opponent a 2/2 flying Bird).

material_candidates.reason: Post-floor sixth swap: the deck had only one repeatable creature-based 3-to-each source (Loyal Subordinate); Swan Song's Bird also blocks menace. The five-swap list keeping Swan Song is staged as the retained alternative.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Six one-for-one swaps that make Davros's end-step condition easier to meet for every opponent (Bloodletter, Purphoros, Fiery Confluence, Tectonic Giant, Unlicensed Disintegration) and punish the discard/sacrifice choices (Tergrid). Losses: Blasphemous Act (Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death and Cyclonic Rift remain), Death in Heaven's delayed creature theft, Vandalblast's one-sided artifact sweep, Swan Song's 1-mana counter, Weeping Angel's 3-mana flash body and The Cyber-Controller. Game Changers 5 -> 6 (Tergrid).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected six-swap package: commander-first. More ways to make every opponent lose 3+ on our turn (Bloodletter doubling, Purphoros per token, Fiery Confluence, Tectonic Giant, Unlicensed Disintegration) and a punisher for the sacrifice/discard options (Tergrid). Lands and colour sources unchanged.
Staged five-swap alternative keeping Swan Song. Retained: more protection for Davros and engines, one fewer repeatable table qualifier.
Staged six-swap keeping Blasphemous Act and cutting Ashad. Rejected: Ashad copies multiply Davros triggers; the wipe kills our own board.
Staged Pass C pairings (Fiery over Angel, Disintegration over This Is How It Ends; Vandalblast kept). Rejected: This Is How It Ends is a villainous-choice qualifier.
Staged seven-swap with Pass C's Artillerist over Sycorax. Rejected by the bounded Artillerist test.
Staged seven-swap with Flame Rift over Ashad. Rejected: self-damage, one-shot, redundant.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C paired Unlicensed Disintegration with Weeping Angel / This Is How It Ends and Fiery Confluence or Ingenious Artillerist with Sycorax Commander / Perforating Artist. Here Disintegration takes Weeping Angel's slot (Pass C's first pairing) and Fiery takes Vandalblast's; the alternative pairing (Fiery over Angel, Disintegration over This Is How It Ends) and Artillerist over Sycorax are staged as complete 100s and rejected. Perforating Artist is kept as an end-step enabler.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The commander only pays off when opponents lose 3+ on our turn, yet the baseline spent slots on Blasphemous Act (kills our own Daleks), a slow two-turn Saga (Death in Heaven), a one-sided artifact sweep, two defensive cards with no life-loss text (Weeping Angel, Swan Song) and an X-cost Cyberman lord shared with Deck #11, and had no amplifier for partial life loss and no punisher for the 'discard/sacrifice' answers opponents give to its choices.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Six swaps, all commander-first: Bloodletter (doubling on our turn), Purphoros (2 per creature entry), Fiery Confluence and Tectonic Giant (table enablers), Unlicensed Disintegration (removal that qualifies) and Tergrid (punishes discard/sacrifice). Bounded Pass C tests are in the mechanics test. Spellbook: still 0 included combos.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five-swap floor, Tectonic Giant over Swan Song was added as a sixth swap, and every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool. Ten post-floor challenges were recorded and rejected on Davros-specific grounds; two larger seven-swap packages (Pass C's Artillerist over Sycorax; Flame Rift over Ashad) are staged as complete 100s.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Artillerist qualifies the table only on 3+ artifact entries in a turn and dies to any ping; Sycorax is itself a villainous choice that deals damage equal to hand size or empties hands for Tinybones.
Flame Rift is 4 to every player including us and a one-shot; Ashad's casualty copies (Roaming Throne, Auton Soldier) add Davros triggers each turn.
Hellrider pings only the attacked player; Raptor punishes every block of our menace army and its sacrifices feed Tergrid.
Impact Tremors is half of Purphoros's output; Mechanaut reduces Davros (an artifact) and the 22 other artifacts.
Archfiend is an 8-mana second Wound Reflection; Squadron's myriad spreads attacking Daleks to all opponents and each copy triggers Purphoros.
Exsanguinate is a one-shot drain; Auton Soldier's non-legendary Davros copy gives a second end-step trigger every turn.
Kroxa needs escape to stay; Voidwalker's 3-power shadow qualifies one opponent each turn despite the disclosed Tergrid anti-synergy.
Painful Quandary's 5-life loss happens on opponents' turns and never counts for our end step; This Is How It Ends is removal plus a villainous choice.
Sheoldred's opponent drain happens on their draw steps, not our turn; Deluge is the last scalable wipe after cutting Blasphemous Act (Their Name Is Death only hits nonartifact creatures).
The owner already cut the same role (Liliana's Caress); Entropic Battlecruiser covers it on an artifact.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Pass C asked to test Ingenious Artillerist; adding it gives a second token-entry burn engine next to Purphoros.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: The bounded test shows Artillerist qualifies the table in fewer enumerated cases than Purphoros, has toughness 1, and Sycorax is itself a villainous-choice damage card.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: A 2-mana fourth one-card table enabler (8 with Bloodletter) for turns without Boltwave or Fiery Confluence.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Flame Rift also costs us 4 life and is single-use; Ashad's copies multiply Davros triggers and artifact count every turn.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at six; the five-swap floor was not used as a target. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on Davros-specific grounds: a villainous-choice damage ETB (Sycorax), trigger-multiplying copies (Ashad, Auton Soldier), block punishment for the menace army (Labyrinth Raptor), a Davros cost reducer (Mechanaut), myriad spread to all opponents (Cybermen Squadron), a reliable evasive qualifier (Dauthi Voidwalker), on-our-turn removal plus choice (This Is How It Ends), the last flexible wipe (Toxic Deluge) and respect for the owner's prior Liliana's Caress cut (Feed the Swarm).
